needsReview.element: Cloudflare Web Analytics beacon blocked by the CSP
needsReview.note: [owner] The beacon (static.cloudflareinsights.com) is injected by the Cloudflare edge setting Web Analytics, not by the app, which has its own web-vitals beacon. Decide: switch the edge setting off (no code change), or approve allowing the host. Allowing the host in script-src would not help under 'strict-dynamic' (host sources are ignored there), so it needs a nonce injected at the edge; the policy is left unchanged and pinned by tests/csp-analytics.test.ts.
